_doc: Death effects for 16 px characters (adopted: the burst and the dizzy stars only). Character animation, hitstop, knockback and timing are done on the Godot side.

burst.pivot_is: character visual center (on the ground where it lands)
burst.when: the moment the body hits the ground (Dead frame 0)

dizzy.note: over the head of the Dead pose
dizzy.when: after the burst, loop until game over / respawn

reuse_for_enemies: both work for any 16 px character
